review_method: Independent manual modular arithmetic and exact alignment review. Only the existing SOURCE1386 lines37-39 in IT/ZL were inspected; no new corpus, vocabulary scan or solver execution.
candidate_basis: Already emitted PREFILTER reported Latin inventory candidates deesse, preesse, piissimi, piissimo. Candidate completeness and vocabulary counts are inherited from that artifact, not independently recounted in this manual review.

original_result_preserved.note: The original registered solver/prefilter decisions are not superseded or relabeled by these posthoc deductions.

fixed_arithmetic: SPACE=0,a..z=1..26. A is decoded qokeedy; B is decoded qokedy. Since their fixed22-unit count vectors differ by one e, weight_e=A-B modulo27. qokechdy minus qokchdy likewise equals weight_e. All values below are conditional on a candidate source-word alignment, not adopted native letter assignments.
